LUMEN — Expedition

Pack your bag, leave town, and gather until the sun sets.

Every node needs the right tool in your bag — and your bag is the only place anything merges. Moving deeper costs sunlight; make it home before dark or your materials scatter (tools always come home). Choose your tools wisely: they take space you'll want for loot.
